info.title: SVSU No-Dues Clearance API
info.description:
### University No-Dues Clearance & Security Deposit Refund System
**Shri Vishwakarma Skill University (SVSU)**

This backend API replaces the manual paper-based clearance system with an automated digital workflow:
1. **Parallel Departmental Clearance**: When a student applies for No-Dues clearance, reviews are immediately dispatched in parallel to all applicable university departments:
   - **ALWAYS**: General service offices (Library, Sports, Account Section, NSS, Dean Student Welfare, etc.)
   - **HOSTELLER_ONLY**: Hostels (Boys/Girls) for residential students
   - **ASSIGNED_ONLY**: Specific laboratories and workshops assigned to the student
   - **OWN_ACADEMIC**: The student's own academic department office
2. **Selective Resubmission**: If any department rejects with remarks, the request enters `ACTION_NEEDED`. The student resolves the dues/issues and resubmits strictly to that specific department.
3. **Chairperson / HoD Final Clearance**: Once all departments have approved, the request moves to `HOD_REVIEW`. The Chairperson (HoD) grants final clearance, triggering issuance of an official Certificate with an unguessable UUID code (for verification).
4. **Post-Clearance Refund**: Verified records transition to Registration & Accounts (`registrar_accounts`) for refund reconciliation.

---
### Clearance Request Lifecycle Statuses
- `SUBMITTED`: Active clearance request dispatched to applicable departments; pending reviews.
- `ACTION_NEEDED`: One or more departments (or the HoD) rejected the request; student action is required.
- `HOD_REVIEW`: All applicable department clearances are approved; pending final review by the student's Academic Chairperson (HoD).
- `CLEARED`: HoD has approved; official clearance certificate generated.
- `REFUND_VERIFIED`: Accounts and Registration have verified the security deposit refund.

---
### System Roles & Access Matrix
- **`student`**: Self-registers via OTP; submits clearance application; tracks progress; resubmits to rejected departments or HoD.
- **`dept_officer`**: Assigned to a specific service or academic department office; approves or rejects student dues for that department with remarks.
- **`hod`**: Academic Chairperson of the student's department; performs final clearance review and issues certificates.
- **`registrar_accounts`**: University accounts section for post-clearance security deposit refund processing.
- **`admin`**: System management and roster administration.

post.description: Initiates student self-registration. Validates that the registration number exists in the student roster, the provided email matches the roster email, the domain is allowed, and that the student has not already created an account. Dispatches a 6-digit OTP.

400.description: Invalid registration number, mismatched email, or disallowed domain

409.description: User account already exists for this student

post.summary: Verify OTP and Create Student Account
post.description: Verifies the received OTP, enforces maximum 5 attempts, validates password length (min 8 chars), creates the User record with student role linked to the roster entry, and returns an access token.

400.description: Invalid, expired, or exceeded attempts OTP, or password too short

409.description: Account already created for this registration number

post.description: Authenticates university students, department officers, HoDs, and administrators. Accepts form data where username is the user's email address. Returns a JWT Bearer access token.

401.description: Incorrect email or password, or account inactive

get.description: Returns profile details for the authenticated user. If the user is a student, includes their academic roster summary, deposit amount, and securely masked bank account number.

post.description: Student initiates a clearance application. The system automatically creates parallel clearance reviews for all applicable departments (always-applicable, hosteller if relevant, assigned labs/workshops, and their own academic department) and registers a refund entry. Only one active request is allowed.

409.description: Student already has an active clearance request

get.description: Returns the active clearance status, progress percentage/ratio, and department-by-department reviews with status, remarks, and resubmission counts.

404.description: No clearance request found for current student

post.description: Allows a student to resubmit their clearance only to a department that previously rejected it. The approval status is reset to PENDING and the resubmission count is incremented. Other departments are untouched.

404.description: Clearance request or department approval not found

409.description: Department approval is not currently in REJECTED status

post.description: When all department approvals are approved but the HoD previously rejected the request with remarks, the student calls this endpoint to clear the HoD remarks and move the request back into HOD_REVIEW.

409.description: Cannot resubmit to HoD until all department rejections are resolved or no HoD remarks pending

get.description: Returns the student's saved bank account details with the account number securely masked (e.g., '********1234') along with IFSC, account holder name, and branch address.

404.description: Bank details not found for this student

put.description: Updates or sets the student's bank details for security deposit refunds. Accepts full account number (digits only, length 9 to 18) and standard IFSC code. The full account number is never echoed back.

400.description: Invalid bank details or missing roster entry

get.description: Generates and downloads the official university No-Dues Clearance Certificate in PDF format. Accessible only to the student who owns the request, and only after final clearance (status CLEARED or REFUND_VERIFIED). Includes an authentic QR code linking to the public verification endpoint.

200.description: Clearance Certificate in PDF binary format

404.description: Clearance request or certificate record not found

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of student clearance requests pending review or previously decided by the officer's assigned department. Returns student identity and programme (never bank details).

post.description: Department officer approves or rejects an applicable clearance request. Remarks are strictly mandatory when rejecting. Recomputes the parent request status.

404.description: Approval record not found or does not belong to officer's department

409.description: Approval record has already been decided

get.description: Returns all clearance requests in HOD_REVIEW status for students enrolled under the Chairperson / HoD's academic department.

400.description: HoD has no assigned academic department

get.description: Returns the full departmental approval history and student details for an academic clearance request. Accessible only if the student belongs to the HoD's department.

404.description: Clearance request not found or belongs to another department

post.summary: Submit Chairperson / HoD Final Clearance Decision
post.description: Chairperson / HoD grants final approval or rejection of the clearance application. Approval sets status to CLEARED and generates an official Certificate record. Rejection (with mandatory remarks) sets status to ACTION_NEEDED.

404.description: Request not found or not in HoD's department

409.description: Request is not in HOD_REVIEW status

get.description: Public endpoint to verify a student's No-Dues clearance certificate using the unique UUID code or scanned QR code. Returns basic academic details and issue timestamp. Protects privacy by strictly masking the registration number and never exposing student names, phone numbers, emails, or financial details.
Returns a paginated list of clearance requests currently in CLEARED status, awaiting security deposit reconciliation and refund verification by the university accounts branch.

post.description: Applies any verified dues/deductions against the initial security deposit. Deductions must satisfy 0 <= deductions <= deposit. Moves the refund status to VERIFIED and request status to REFUND_VERIFIED. Executes atomically with row locking and logs an audit trail.

400.description: Request not in CLEARED status or invalid deduction limits

404.description: Clearance request or refund record not found

post.description: Records the bank payment reference (UTR/NEFT) once the refund amount is disbursed to the student's verified bank account. Requires the refund to have been VERIFIED previously.

400.description: Refund not in VERIFIED status yet

404.description: Clearance request or refund record not found

post.description: Uploads a CSV file containing student roster records. Validates each row: non-empty credentials, valid email format, known programme name, valid hosteller flag, and non-negative deposit. Performs an upsert based on registration_number and returns a row-by-row status report. Does NOT create user accounts.

400.description: Invalid CSV file format or headers

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of student roster records with optional search filter.

parameters.name: search

schema.description: Search by registration number, name, or email
schema.title: Search

parameters.description: Search by registration number, name, or email

patch.description: Updates hosteller status, security deposit amount, address, or mobile for a roster record.

put.description: Replaces assigned laboratory and workshop departments for a student roster profile.

post.description: Provisions a new staff user (dept_officer, hod, or registrar_accounts). Department is mandatory for officers and HoDs. HoDs must be assigned to an academic department. Automatically generates a secure random temporary password and returns it ONCE in the response (never logged).

400.description: Invalid role, missing department, or non-academic HoD

409.description: User with this email already exists

post.description: Generates a new random temporary password for any user account and returns it once in the response.

patch.description: Enables or disables a user account. Deactivated accounts are refused login immediately. An administrator is prevented from deactivating their own account.

400.description: Admin cannot deactivate their own account

role.description: Allowed staff role: dept_officer, hod, or registrar_accounts
